name: Mudskipper
desc: Fish that crawls over mudflats at low tide scraping green algae, and is also found in Kuwait Sulaibikhat Bay.
about: Boleophthalmus boddarti, commonly known as Boddart's goggle-eyed goby, is a species of mudskipper native to the Indo-Pacific, and the type species of the genus Boleophthalmus.
